text: Regarding the question 'how many members are in the lok sabha?': The Lok Sabha, the lower house of India's Parliament, has a maximum strength of 552 members as per the Constitution, with the current effective strength around 543 elected members.

text: Regarding the question 'how do i reset a forgotten email password?': Most email providers let you reset a forgotten password using the 'Forgot Password' link, which sends a verification code to your registered phone number or recovery email.

text: Regarding the question 'how do i check my aadhaar card status?': You can check your Aadhaar card status on the UIDAI website by entering your enrollment number or Aadhaar number.

text: Regarding the question 'how do i track a courier shipment?': Most courier services provide a tracking number that can be entered on their website or app to view real-time shipment status.

title: General Knowledge
text: Regarding the question 'what is inflation?': Inflation is the rate at which the general price level of goods and services rises, reducing purchasing power over time.

title: General Knowledge
text: Regarding the question 'what is gdp?': GDP, or Gross Domestic Product, is the total monetary value of all goods and services produced within a country in a given period.

title: General Knowledge
text: Regarding the question 'what is the reserve bank of india?': The Reserve Bank of India is the country's central bank, responsible for regulating the monetary policy and issuing currency.

title: General Knowledge
text: Regarding the question 'what is a startup?': A startup is a young company founded to develop a unique product or service, often characterized by rapid growth and innovation.

title: General Knowledge
text: Regarding the question 'what is renewable energy?': Renewable energy comes from natural sources that replenish continuously, such as sunlight, wind, and water.

title: General Knowledge
text: Regarding the question 'what is a solar eclipse?': A solar eclipse occurs when the Moon passes between the Sun and the Earth, temporarily blocking the Sun's light.

title: General Knowledge
text: Regarding the question 'what is a lunar eclipse?': A lunar eclipse occurs when the Earth passes between the Sun and the Moon, casting a shadow on the Moon.

text: Regarding the question 'what is the isro?': ISRO, the Indian Space Research Organisation, is India's national space agency responsible for the country's space programme.

text: Regarding the question 'what is digital india?': Digital India is a government initiative aimed at transforming India into a digitally empowered society through improved online infrastructure and services.

title: General Knowledge
text: Regarding the question 'what is make in india?': Make in India is a government initiative launched to encourage companies to manufacture products within India and boost investment.

title: General Knowledge
text: Regarding the question 'what is gst in india?': GST, or Goods and Services Tax, is an indirect tax levied on the supply of goods and services across India, replacing many earlier indirect taxes.

title: General Knowledge
text: Regarding the question 'what is net neutrality?': Net neutrality is the principle that internet service providers must treat all data on the internet equally, without discriminating by content or user.

title: General Knowledge
text: Regarding the question 'what is a cyclone?': A cyclone is a large-scale system of winds rotating around a low-pressure center, often bringing heavy rain and strong winds.

title: General Knowledge
text: Regarding the question 'what is biodiversity?': Biodiversity refers to the variety of living organisms, including plants, animals, and microorganisms, found within a particular ecosystem or on Earth as a whole.

title: General Knowledge
text: Regarding the question 'what is the midday meal scheme?': The Midday Meal Scheme is an Indian government programme that provides free lunches to schoolchildren to improve nutrition and encourage school attendance.

title: General Knowledge
text: Regarding the question 'what is the national education policy 2020?': The National Education Policy 2020 is a comprehensive framework for reforming India's education system, from school to higher education.

title: General Knowledge
text: Regarding the question 'what is a monument of national importance?': A monument of national importance is a heritage site in India protected and maintained by the Archaeological Survey of India due to its historical significance.

title: General Knowledge
text: Regarding the question 'what is the swachh bharat mission?': The Swachh Bharat Mission is a nationwide campaign launched in India to eliminate open defecation and improve solid waste management.

title: General Knowledge
text: Regarding the question 'what is a union territory in india?': A Union Territory is an administrative division in India governed directly by the central government, unlike states which have their own elected governments.

title: General Knowledge
text: Regarding the question 'what is the difference between weather and climate?': Weather refers to short-term atmospheric conditions in a specific place, while climate describes long-term average weather patterns over a larger region and time period.
